# Input lies in its transcript class

**Claim.** The input pair generated by any hard sample belongs to the class of input pairs whose protocol execution follows the transcript produced on that input.

**Proof.** A protocol's transcript records, at each step, the bit sent by the relevant party, and its transcript class imposes precisely those bit conditions along the protocol path. Every input pair belongs to the class indexed by its own transcript: at an output node the class is the whole input space, and at each Alice or Bob node the input supplies the recorded bit and then belongs to the class for the resulting continuation. This is the general membership property of a protocol transcript (`CommunicationComplexity.Deterministic.Protocol.mem_transcript`). Applying it to the input pair generated by the sample proves the claim.

**Key facts.** `CommunicationComplexity.Deterministic.Protocol.mem_transcript`.
